Initially this Public Interest Litigation was initiated by Tanvi Ahuja, who has since expired.
Consequently the title of this case shall now be altered to "Court on its own motion v. State of Jammu and Kashmir and others".
The Registry shall take steps to alter the cause title.

2. The inspection report in respect of the Observation Home at Harwan, carried out by one of us ( Justice Ali Mohammad Magrey, who is the Chairman of the Juvenile Justice Committee, High Court of Jammu and Kashmir), is taken on record.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice Committee, High Court of Jammu and Kashmir
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The Social Welfare Department as well as the Home Department are directed to file their action taken reports on the deficiencies pointed out in the said inspection report,
particularly with regard to the conditions of the Juveniles, who are lodged in the said Observation Home at Harwan.
This would include their dietary conditions, general ambience of the home as also the quality of water and food which is provided to the said Juveniles.

3. A copy of the inspection report be provided to the learned counsel for the Social Tanvi Ahuja vs State Of JK & Ors on 4 July, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94297105/

sentences.text: Welfare Department as well as the Home Department.

4. We also require the respondents, i.e., both the Social Welfare Department and the Home Department of the Government of Jammu and Kashmir, to provide information with regard to Juveniles in conflict with law under the following heads:-
(1) How many Juveniles in conflict with law are lodged in Jails/ Police custody?
(2) How many Juveniles in conflict with law have been apprehended by the Police during the last one year and whether the prescriptions of Rule 11 (1) and 11 (2) have been strictly complied with, whenever any such Juvenile in conflict with law has been apprehended?
(3) Whether the procedure prescribed by Rule 12 (2) has been followed in letter and spirit in respect of the above mentioned Juveniles in conflict with law.
The relevant record shall also be produced in Digital form?
(4) Are there any Juvenile or Child Welfare Officers, as required under the Act and the Rules?

(5)
How many Observation Homes and places of safety have been established in the State of Jammu and Kashmir?
(6) Whether free legal aid, as is required to be provided under the Act and Rules, is being provided to the Juveniles in conflict with law?

This aspect shall also be addressed by the Member Secretary,
State Legal Services Authority, who is present in Court and a report be submitted by him in this behalf.

(7) The respondent- State shall also clearly indicate as to whether the standards of institutions for care and protection, as prescribed under Chapter IV of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Rules, 2014, have been implemented or not?

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Rules, 2014
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. We also direct Mr. Shah Faisal and Mr. Omais Kawoosa, Advocates to assist this Court in ascertaining the above questions.

For this purpose, they shall be permitted to visit all the Observation Homes and Jails and the Home Department as well as the Social Welfare Department shall extend all facilities to them to enable them to have meaningful visits of the above places.
6.
The reports be submitted within two weeks by all concerned.

7. Insofar as the creation of additional posts of 22 Judicial Magistrates ( First Class) is concerned,
we had directed the Registry to initiate steps by virtue of our order dated 17.05.2017.

The Registry has already initiated steps and a communication has been addressed to the Secretary to the Government, Department of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Government of J&K, Civil Secretariat, Srinagar by the Registrar General on 22.06.2017 concerning the creation of the said 22 posts.

entities.text: Department of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The Law Secretary is directed to file a response to the same within two weeks.
